# Trackpad Requirements Checklist: Trackpad-Native Drift UX

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of arbitration, targeting at begin, glide, cancel, mode changes, L6 coverage
and host safety (spec, plan, research, contracts of Feature 003)
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Arbitration

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified, for every finger count (2, 3, 4+) and kind (scroll, swipe, pinch), whether the input is consumed, ignored or passed through on a Drift monitor? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-011, contracts/gesture-model.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Do the "never trigger a 3-finger binding in Drift" requirement and the "layer surface / fullscreen passes through" requirement agree for a 3-finger gesture that begins over a layer surface or with a fullscreen window? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the set of compositor gesture bindings that must not fire defined by finger count rather than by a fixed list of actions, so that bindings the user adds later are covered? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are 4-finger pinches (not only horizontal swipes) addressed in Drift? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the behavior of a 2-finger swipe (if a device reports one) specified? [Edge Case, contracts/gesture-model.md rule 9]

## Targeting at begin

- [ ] CHK006 Is "the surface under the pointer" at begin defined for all surface kinds (window, popup, subsurface, decoration/border, layer surface, layer popup, empty canvas)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the beginning of a two-finger scroll sequence defined precisely (first non-zero finger-source event while none is open)? [Clarity, research R3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the end of a scroll sequence defined both for devices that send a stop and for devices that never do, and is the consequence for glide stated? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases, research R3]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated that a modifier released mid-sequence does not change the target? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the monitor that owns a sequence defined when the pointer crosses to another output mid-sequence? [Gap]

## Pan and zoom quantities

- [ ] CHK011 Is the pan distance for two-finger scrolls specified with its sign convention and factors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, contracts/drift-control.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the pan distance for 3-finger swipes specified consistently with two-finger pans, including whether the pan factor applies? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, contracts/drift-control.md]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the pinch anchor defined (begin pointer) and is the zoom defined relative to the camera at begin rather than incrementally? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, research R4]
- [ ] CHK014 Are zoom-limit requirements consistent with Feature 002's range [0.1, 2.0]? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]

## Cancel and mode changes

- [ ] CHK015 Is "cancelled gesture" defined, and is the restore target (camera at begin) stated for both pan and zoom gestures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for Drift off, panic, workspace change and monitor loss during a consumed gesture, including that remaining events stay consumed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, research R8]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the case of Drift turned on in the middle of a passed-through sequence specified? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are interactions between trackpad sequences and Feature 002 Super + drag defined in both orders (drag first, gesture first)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, research R7]

## Glide

- [ ] CHK019 Is the release-speed rule specified deterministically (window, rest limit, clamp) so that tests can compute the expected value? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, contracts/gesture-model.md]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the glide strength mapping from the 0–1 setting to friction documented, including 0 = off? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, research R5]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the complete list of glide interruptions specified, and is "within one frame" measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified which pans may glide (two-finger, Super + two-finger, 3-finger) and that zoom never glides? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the "no frames after the glide" requirement tied to a measurement method that does not poll? [Measurability, Spec SC-005, research R6]

## L6 coverage and validation limits

- [ ] CHK024 Are the L6 items that can be performed in a nested session listed separately from the BLOCKED ones, with the reason and the evidence each BLOCKED item carries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, research R11]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the condition for closing the BLOCKED L6 items (a later approved hardware session) stated without creating a new gate? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a visible nested session for L6 specified, given that the automated sessions render only to a headless output? [Gap, plan Phase 1]
- [ ] CHK027 Is U4 recorded as an open assumption with its consequence for 3-finger pan? [Assumption, Spec Edge Cases, research R13]

## Host safety

- [ ] CHK028 Are the host's 3- and 4-finger actions (close, fullscreen, float, special, workspace, suspend) named as a hazard for the human during L6, with the instruction to avoid them? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it specified that synthetic test input reaches only the verified nested session and that the test-only plugin never ships? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK030 Is it specified that bindings running commands (the host's suspend) are never copied into the nested test config? [Gap, contracts/test-tooling.md §5]
